ad6e0e3030d8eba97ef2e7d224e77922118ce9c6.sourceText: SolidWorks是一种计算机辅助设计（CAD）和计算机辅助制造（CAM）软件，由Dassault Systèmes SolidWorks Corp.开发。它主要用于工程设计和制造，可用于创建3D三维模型、进行装配设计、进行工程分析和绘图等。SolidWorks具有直观的用户界面和强大的功能，使工程师和设计师能够快速而精确地设计复杂的零部件和装配体。该软件广泛应用于机械、航空航天、汽车、医疗设备等行业，是工程设计领域的重要工具之一。
ad6e0e3030d8eba97ef2e7d224e77922118ce9c6.translatedText: SolidWorks is a computer\-aided design (CAD) and computer\-aided manufacturing (CAM) software developed by Dassault Systèmes SolidWorks Corp\. It is mainly used for engineering design and manufacturing, and can be used to create 3D models, perform assembly design, carry out engineering analysis and drafting, etc\. SolidWorks has an intuitive user interface and powerful features, enabling engineers and designers to quickly and accurately design complex parts and assemblies\. The software is widely used in machinery, aerospace, automotive, medical equipment, and other industries, and is one of the important tools in the field of engineering design\.
